next.reason: 1985 'The I-O status ... is set to a value indicating the invalid key condition (See ... I-O Status)'; §2023:9.1.14 GR1 'set to a value indicating the invalid key condition as described in 9.1.13.5', whose relative-file values are §2023:9.1.13.5 GR2, GR3, GR4. The added 'if enabled, the EC-I-O-INVALID-KEY exception condition is set to exist' is nonfatal and acts only when checking is enabled, so the status and control flow of a 1985 program are unchanged.
